lines.text: The LORD calls Ararat, Minni, Ashkenaz, and the kings of the Medes to prepare for battle against Babylon.
Babylon's warriors sit in their strongholds, and messengers tell the king that his city has been captured from end to end.
The LORD says Babylon is like a threshing floor being trampled, and Jerusalem says Pharaoh devoured and crushed her.
The LORD will plead Jerusalem's case, dry up Babylon's sea, and serve the people a feast so they sleep forever.
Babylon's cities become a desolation, and the LORD will punish Molech, so the nations no longer stream to him.
